title: host serve: a missing workspace directory surfaces as an opaque terminal refusal
body:
## What happened

On the Mac host, `openagents computer exec mac -- CMD` returned:

```
The computer can't open a terminal now. Its host may serve no workspace.
```

The host had a workspace configured in `serve.json` (`openagents=/Users/.../work/openagents-host-tasks`), but the directory no longer existed. `terminal.open` spawned a PTY with a missing working directory, the spawn failed, and the host answered `unavailable`. Nothing in `host.log` recorded the cause. Creating the directory fixed it.

## Expected

- `host serve` checks each workspace path at start and logs a line naming the missing path (or creates it when it is under the host's own root).
- The `terminal.open` refusal distinguishes "no workspace configured" from "workspace path unusable" so the client message can say which.

## Scope

`crates/coder-host/src/serve/{mod,dispatch}.rs`, the client message in `crates/coder-computers/src/terminal/session.rs`, and a test for each refusal.
